scope: Independent C# review of selection persistence, command guards, quantity declaration and source-proportional work; actual source methods compiled with minimal CAD doubles.

findings.reproduced: A zone mark without ATFRAME plus its explicitly selected canonical hatch falsely conflicted; the dialog could keep legacy calculation settings.
findings.resolution: Alias and canonical observations are distinct. Null aliases do not create legacy zones; explicit aliases must match. Verified canonical metadata is read before the dialog and the complete first explicit canonical settings are restored.
findings.verified: Both selection orders pass; conflicting aliases, explicit alias with legacy canonical and a genuinely different legacy/new zone refuse. Legacy calc/height/steps are replaced together, later canonicals do not overwrite the first settings.

findings.reproduced: Clamps-only outer-plus-hole could pass the actual-zone selection guard while the metadata writer also included a previous root excluded as a hole.
findings.resolution: ValidateClampsRoots refuses any prior frame root absent from the engine result before drawing mutation.
findings.verified: Real engine outer/hole fixture and extracted actual command gate accept the outer alone and refuse the excluded previous hole; unchanged exact selection is required for clamps.

findings.reproduced: An existing empty ATFRAME Xrecord was indistinguishable from absent legacy metadata.
findings.resolution: The actual reader distinguishes absent dictionaries/keys from empty or malformed records; the ResultBuffer property is read once inside using.
findings.verified: Actual extracted reader accepts absent legacy data and valid selection; null Data, empty text, non-text-only and malformed JSON refuse. Every non-null buffer is disposed exactly once on success and refusal.

findings.reproduced: Moving zone verification before the form removes selected zone contours from polyData before manual-axis bounds are calculated.
findings.resolution: The original selected contours are snapshotted before deduplication and the existing bounding loop reads that snapshot.
findings.verified: Actual extracted snapshot and bounds loop retain outer/opening bounds after polyData is emptied; no additional CAD read or geometry pass.

findings.reproduced: A list of aliases rechecked for every canonical observation produced quadratic comparisons for one merged root.
findings.resolution: One checked explicit alias snapshot is stored per root; null aliases require no stored snapshot.
findings.verified: 100 aliases plus 100 canonicals produce 200 observations and 199 comparisons; 1000 plus 1000 produce 2000 observations and 1999 comparisons. Resolution visits one distinct root.

tests.methods: Actual source extraction for metadata/freshness/result guards and axis bounds; real FrameSettings/FrameSolutionSelection/quantity producer and Python engine.
additional_boundaries: Changed or erased canonical owner refuses before write.
Selected-owner reread ignores an unrelated corrupt object.
Global convenience settings exclude project selection and SaveLast follows transaction commit.
Engine echo must retain exact declaration and explicit limitations; quantity rows retain null product_id.

architecture_review.evidence: FrameCommand diff adds selected-owner and verified-canonical metadata reads only; existing whole-drawing paths are unchanged. Initial selected canonical metadata is cached; prewrite reread is intentional freshness validation.
architecture_review.same_root_alias_matching: linear in observations; exact comparison counters asserted

preserved_limits: Historical nomenclature membership is not assembly or strength approval.
No automatic bracket-length equation, installed-product assignment or invented section properties.
Geometric cladding-front offset remains separate from the calculation lever arm.
Unsupported systems and existing NSP-2/GP-60-40 calculation restrictions remain outside this catalogue declaration.
acceptance_boundary: This receipt closes the listed source-level defects and synthetic regressions. Full repository gates, compilation, UI checks and live AutoCAD acceptance have separate evidence.
